text:
incident-bot: ALERT: High error rate (GPU OOM) in serving-runtime-us-west-1. Severity: P1. Incident channel created. Pager: @mira.

mira (oncall): I'm seeing a spike of CUDA OOMs on a subset of pods in svc-infer-prod-usw. Errors look like `cudaMalloc failed: out of memory` even though node reports ~6GB headroom. Routing has started failing for some low-latency endpoints.

samir: can you paste the container logs and nvidia-smi? curious if reserved blocks / fragmentation is showing.

mira (oncall): pasting snippets below:
```
[2026-03-15T08:12:34Z] runtime: alloc failed: cudaMalloc 10485760 -> ERR_OUT_OF_MEMORY
[2026-03-15T08:12:34Z] allocator: reserved_blocks: [1.5GB, 1.5GB], free_regions: 3, largest_free: 380MB
[2026-03-15T08:12:34Z] kv-cache: pinned_prefixes: 6, kv_reserved: 1.2GB
```

```
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| NVIDIA-SMI 515.76       Driver Version: 515.76       CUDA Version: 11.7     |
| GPU  Name        Persistence-M| Bus-Id        Disp.A | Volatile Uncorr. ECC |
| 0    A100-SXM4-40G     On      | 00000000:00:1E.0 Off |                    0 |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Fan  Temp  Perf  Pwr:Usage/Cap| Memory-Usage | GPU-Util |
| 0   46C   P0    80W / 400W    | 32800MiB / 40960MiB | 89%     |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------+
```

leo: that memory usage looks high but not full. Large fragmentation: largest contiguous free ~380MB explains why allocations for ~1GB buffers fail. Might be allocator fragmentation + reserved KV cache.

harini: can we temporarily disable KV cache on the affected model shard? That should free contiguous ranges. Also suggest lowering max_batch_tokens to reduce peak allocs.

mira (oncall): running `kubectl exec` to disable kv-cache flag for model=redwood-4x-shard-7: `REDWOOD_KV_CACHE=off` then rollout restart. Doing one pod at a time.

infra-bot: node node-ussw-12 shows OOM events and high reserved memory fragmentation. Disk paging observed at kernel level: "oom_killer invoked" absent, but high swap activity.

mira (oncall): doing canary restart on pod svc-infer-prod-usw-7. Observed immediate recovery of allocations on restarted pod, but other pods still hitting OOM.

samir: if restarts help, this suggests allocator state leakage over long-lived containers (fragmentation + persistent reserved blocks). Short-term: restart all pods on the node pool with rolling restart + stagger to avoid capacity loss. Medium-term: we need an allocator patch to defragment/free reserved blocks on config toggle.

support-bot: Customer impact summary (e2e): 2 customer-facing routes degraded: realtime-chat (5.6% errors, baseline 0.2%) and doc-summarization (3.1% errors). No SSO or billing impact. ETA to mitigation: 30-45m for rolling restart.

mira (oncall): initiating rolling restart of affected nodepool group=p-ussw-infer-3 with maxUnavailable=1. Notifying SAC and SRE.

chao (handoff): I'm taking over the incident, mirroring context. Oncall rotation note: handoff at 08:20Z. Mira — anything uncommitted I should pick up?

mira (oncall): all actions: disabling KV cache for the shard, canary pod restarted and healthy, rolling restart in progress. Observed error rate start dropping after first node drain. Logs show intermittent `cudaErrorMemoryAllocation` rather than persistent.

chao (handoff): OK. I'll coordinate traffic ramp-down for the two affected customers if error rate doesn't continue to drop. Also will request a temporary autoscale add for low-latency tier to reduce per-pod load.

leo: for the postmortem item: we should add an automated eviction path for large pinned KV caches when contiguous free < threshold (e.g., <512MB). Also add a runtime metric: "largest_free_segment_bytes" per GPU to alert before allocation failure.

harini: confirm plan to patch: (1) allocator defrag on flag flip; (2) reduce default kv-reserved for high-concurrency models; (3) add eviction policy and alert.

infra-bot: rolling restart progress: 3 / 9 pods restarted, node-ussw-12 drained and cordoned, next drain node-ussw-14 scheduled in 2m.

support-bot: Customer comms draft: "We observed transient request failures due to GPU memory fragmentation in our inference fleet in US-WEST. We are performing rolling restarts to restore service and will follow up with a detailed postmortem. No customer data exposure. ETA to full recovery: 1h." Approve? :thumbsup: :thumbsdown:

chao (handoff): approve, send now and mark affected customers as incident subscribers.

mira (oncall): one more log piece — when OOM happens, allocator reports: `reserved_block_count=2, reserved_block_size=1610612736` (i.e., two 1.5GB blocks). So small free regions get split and we can't allocate a contiguous ~1GB transient buffer. This matches fragmentation theory.

leo: also note that some kernels request pinned linear buffers which can't be allocated from noncontiguous fragments. That makes fragmentation more painful for some models.

chao (handoff): I'm coordinating with runtime-eng to get an emergency patch for making reserved blocks reclaimable when KV cache is disabled or when free largest block < threshold. If they can't push fast enough, we'll schedule a controlled full rolling restart of the pool during low-traffic window (approx 23:00Z).

infra-bot: alert: error rate now down to 2.9% system-wide after 5/9 pods restarted. Memory fragmentation metric largest_free_segment_bytes increasing on restarted pods.

support-bot: Updated customer impact: realtime-chat errors down to 1.4%, doc-summarization 0.9%. Customers notified.

chao (handoff): next steps captured: 1) complete rolling restart (target: 60m), 2) runtime patch for reclaimable reserved blocks, 3) add largest_free_segment_bytes alert, 4) postmortem and customer RCA. Assign owners: samir(runtime), leo(telemetry), harini(runtime-config), mira(incident writeup).

mira (oncall): thanks team. I'll hand off final Slack updates and start draft for postmortem. Marking incident as "mitigated" once error rate <1% for 15m.

incident-bot: Incident update recorded. Severity remains P1 until final verification.

chao (handoff): closing loop: if any pod still hits OOM after full restart + config changes, we'll schedule a constrained canary to run a memory allocation stress test to reproduce and get a heap/alloc snapshot.

support-bot: Incident timeline and current metrics attached to ticket #INC-2026-1987.

mira (oncall): thanks all — handing off on-call to chao. I'm offline for scheduled window.

chao (handoff): acknowledged. Taking the lead. Will file postmortem draft after mitigation completes. :white_check_mark:"
